description: Performs security-focused differential review of code changes (PRs, commits, diffs). Adapts analysis depth to codebase size, uses git history for context, calculates blast radius, checks test coverage, adjudicates candidate findings against the current contract, and generates comprehensive markdown reports. Automatically detects and prevents security regressions without promoting policy or partial evidence into defects.
